_readme: Cursor adapter for claude-memes. Copy to <project>/.cursor/hooks.json or ~/.cursor/hooks.json with the claude-memes binary on PATH. Cursor's hook payloads differ from Claude Code's, so this adapter is fully observe-only: it records payload field shapes (`claude-memes shapes`, field names only — never values) so detection can be wired against real schemas in a later release. Cursor hooks are beta and IDE-only for most events. Status: experimental.
